entries.title: Settlement Survival

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Settlement Survival is a PC city-builder with Steam Workshop support and a later paid mobile port on iOS/Android. The Steam release is the highest-fidelity route and the best archive target because it has the native desktop interface, Workshop ecosystem, and clean capture path; the Deluxe Edition adds the soundtrack rather than a gameplay-complete edition split.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release for archive capture. Use the mobile port only for portable comparison, not as the definitive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Deluxe Edition bundles the soundtrack with the base game; it is not a remaster or gameplay-complete edition.
